fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/store/... ./internal/entry/... passes, and make self-check passes. Checks: block gives RHIZA_CPUPROFILE of $TMPDIR/rhiza-x check, built at the parent commit and at the commit, in the main checkout, with the pprof -top -cum lines of store.readEntries, entry.Decode and canon.Canonicalize, store.readEntries' share falling, and each run's user+sys CPU from /usr/bin/time. Failure case: a new test in internal/store reads a log holding an entry file that is not canonical and one that fails to parse, and gets the same errors as before the cut; the before and after binaries' rhiza check --json in the main checkout print the same bytes and exit code; the existing store and entry tests keep passing unchanged
fields.must_not: Change the log's file format; accept an entry file the current reader refuses; change which findings rhiza check reports, their severity, rule or text; lower the 5 s target or any budget test threshold
fields.statement: rhiza check's read of the log costs less: store.readEntries' decode of every entry file (readEntry, entry.Decode and canon.Canonicalize: 17% of a RHIZA_CPUPROFILE of rhiza check in the main checkout on 2026-11-18, canon.Canonicalize 10.5% of the whole) is cut in internal/store and internal/entry, every entry still decoded and checked as strictly as before

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/model/... ./internal/check/... passes, and make self-check passes. Checks: block gives RHIZA_CPUPROFILE of $TMPDIR/rhiza-x check, built at the parent commit and at the commit, with the pprof -top -cum lines of model.whatIf, model.whatIfLayer and (*builder).finishModel, their share falling; and $TMPDIR/rhiza-base, built at the change set's base 5d2596d (a git worktree under $TMPDIR), and $TMPDIR/rhiza-x, built at the commit, run alternately five times each back to back in the main checkout after one warm call of each, each run's user+sys CPU taken from /usr/bin/time -f '%e s %U user %S sys' for rhiza check, the median of $TMPDIR/rhiza-x's at most 59% (5 s / 8.4 s) of the median of $TMPDIR/rhiza-base's. Failure case: the parent commit's and the commit's binaries' rhiza check --json in the main checkout print the same bytes and exit code, and a new test in internal/model/view_test.go builds a what-if view over a change set whose op the fold refuses and gets the same problem as before the cut; the existing model and check tests keep passing unchanged
fields.must_not: Change which findings rhiza check reports, their severity, rule or text; change the log's file format; lower the 5 s target or any budget test threshold
fields.statement: Each in-flight change set's what-if view in rhiza check costs less to finish: model.whatIf's whatIfLayer and (*builder).finishModel (8.4% of the 2026-11-18 profile of rhiza check, beside the Seed.builder copying whatif-copies-only-written cuts) are cut in internal/model, and once check-log-decode-cheaper, whatif-copies-only-written and check-inflight-links-own-only have landed with it, rhiza check's CPU is within m39-check-fast's 5 s target in proportion: at most 5/8.4 of the base binary's

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath -count=1 -p 2 ./internal/api -run 'Inbox|Plan' passes. Checks: block gives RHIZA_CPUPROFILE of a warm $TMPDIR/rhiza-x inbox, built at the parent commit and at the commit, with the pprof -top -cum lines of inboxBlockers, planGather and planCore, their share falling; and $TMPDIR/rhiza-base, built at the change set's base 5d2596d (a git worktree under $TMPDIR), and $TMPDIR/rhiza-x, built at the commit, run alternately five times each back to back in the main checkout after one warm call of each, each run's user+sys CPU taken from /usr/bin/time -f '%e s %U user %S sys' for rhiza inbox, the median of $TMPDIR/rhiza-x's at most 31% (200 ms / 645 ms) of the median of $TMPDIR/rhiza-base's. Failure case: the parent commit's and the commit's binaries' rhiza inbox --json, run back to back in the main checkout, print the same bytes, and a new test in internal/api lists a proposed change set's blocking question as before with the same text while a draft set's blocker stays unlisted; the existing inbox and plan tests keep passing unchanged
fields.must_not: Change which items rhiza inbox lists, their text or the --json shape; change what rhiza plan reports; change the run journal or log file format; lower the 200 ms target or any budget test threshold
fields.statement: rhiza inbox's blocker items cost less: inboxBlockers' planGather and planCore over the to-be view (changeset.(*Analysis).graph and Closure: 6.7% of a warm RHIZA_CPUPROFILE of rhiza inbox in the main checkout on 2026-11-18) are cut in internal/api, and once inbox-run-list-cached and inbox-proposals-overlay-once have landed with it, a warm rhiza inbox's CPU is within m39-reads-fast's 200 ms target in proportion: at most 200/645 of the base binary's

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza passes; go test -list '.*' ./cmd/rhiza and the count of cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/*.txtar are unchanged. Checks: block gives, before and after, /usr/bin/time -f '%e s %U user %S sys' go test -trimpath -count=1 -cpuprofile $TMPDIR/ship.prof ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/run-ship' with the go tool pprof -top -cum lines of the cost cut, the after run's user+sys CPU below the before's; and /usr/bin/time -f '%e s %U user %S sys' go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api ./cmd/rhiza ./internal/index run once at the commit and once in a git worktree at the change set's base 5d2596d under $TMPDIR, back to back, the commit's user+sys CPU at most 60% (240 s / 400 s) of the base's, both wall times reported. Failure case: a scratch copy of one run-ship script with its expected output changed still fails under the changed harness (named in the Checks: block, not committed), so the cut skips no assertion
fields.files: cmd/rhiza/main_test.go, cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/run-ship-*.txtar only where the cut moves a script's setup
fields.must_not: Add a script to processScripts; delete, skip or merge a script or a line of one; change non-test code outside cmd/rhiza/main_test.go; touch the network, Rex, agents or gh; regenerate cmd/rhiza/testdata/script-timings.tsv by hand; lower the 240 s target or any budget test threshold
fields.statement: The cold suite's critical path shortens: cmd/rhiza's run-ship scripts (run-ship-ci-fix, run-ship-conflict-fix, run-ship-conflict-fix-more, run-ship-change-rebase, run-ship-model-conflict, run-ship-land-conflict and run-ship-change, about 95 s of the 864 script-seconds in cmd/rhiza/testdata/script-timings.tsv) stop paying for the top cost a go test -cpuprofile of them names outside the commands they check after scripts-top-cost-cut, cut in cmd/rhiza's test harness; and once api-tests-copy-prebuilt-index and scripts-top-cost-cut have landed with it, a cold run of the three slowest packages is within m39-cold's 240 s target in proportion: at most 240/400 of the base's CPU
